_about: Age and sex by image source over the persons of the frozen G3 split (tools/age_sex_by_source.py). Rows 'nhanes_annotated' and 'cobra_detector' are subsets of 'nhanes' and 'cobra'. Sources that release nothing carry released=false and a note on what their tags actually hold.

ctsp.label: CTSpinoPelvic1K (abdominopelvic CT)

metadata_files.what: release manifest, fields age / sex per volume_id

ctsp.note: Age and sex are the release manifest's per-record fields, populated where the source TCIA collection published them (descriptor: 393 female, 345 male, 11 'other', 53 none; age on 709). Ages of 89 are the TCIA top-code (n=31 at 89). 'other' is a recorded DICOM value and is excluded from the female/male denominator.

ts.label: TotalSegmentator v2 and v3 (whole-body CT; scans)
ts.note: No patient identifier exists in TotalSegmentator; the person key is the canonical v3.0.0 scan id after the v2->v3 alias fold, so these are scans, not persons. meta.csv carries age (years, may be blank) and gender (m/f, blank on some rows); rows read: {'v3.0.0 meta.csv': 1939, 'v2.0.1 meta.csv': 1228}.

verse.label: VerSe 19/20 (spine CT)
verse.note: VerSe organisers' demographics table (one row per subject; multi-series subjects verse400-417 fold to one row). Sex coded 0 = f, 1 = m in the column header.

csxa.label: CSXA (cervical lateral radiographs)
csxa.note: CSXA descriptor table 'Basic information': column 'Gender: female-1, male-0' and 'Age', one row per individual (Number = the 4-digit sequence in the file name). The table, not the file-name tail, is the source; the tail disagrees with it on 2 individuals (['0873166', '3556142']).

buu.label: BUU-LSPINE (lumbar AP and lateral radiographs)
buu.note: BUU-LSPINE v1 dataset report, sheet Pos_LA (filename, gender, age; the AP sheet agrees). Person = the 4-digit case number; the two byte-identical case pairs of the split (0140/0719, 0449/0629) are one person each, so 3,598 persons for 3,600 cases. The report's own Summary sheet counts F 2280 / M 1320 over the 3,600 cases.

nhanes.label: NHANES II (lateral survey films): every sample person keyed in the split
nhanes.note: NHANES II releases no demographics with the films; the SEQN in the file name (CDC: 'can be used to access data from the main NHANES II public use datasets') joins tape 5301 (Anthropometry, examined persons), cols 1-5 SEQN, col 55 Q4 SEX, cols 190-191 AGE YEARS AT EXAMINATION (layout from DU5301.sas). Sex code 1 = male, 2 = female, checked by median standing height at 25+ years: code 1 1743 mm, code 2 1608.0 mm (consistent). Ages are integer years at examination; the survey enrolled to 74 years at interview, so age at examination tops out at 75.

nhanes_annotated.label: NHANES II: the 364 persons with released level annotations (the level-bank people of Table 1)
nhanes_annotated.note: Subset of the row above: the sample persons whose films carry the Zenodo 10223910 annotations (543 films; these are the NHANES persons in the level bank and in Table 1).

vindr.label: VinDr-SpineXR (AP and lateral radiographs; studies)

metadata_files.what: per-image PatientAge/PatientSex from the DICOM headers (job 40438307)

vindr.note: PatientAge / PatientSex read from every DICOM header (job 40438307); person = StudyInstanceUID. Raw PatientSex values over images: {'F': 6499, 'M': 3837, 'O': 128, 'U': 2}; studies whose images disagree on age or sex: 0.

cobra.label: COBRA2026 (radiotherapy kV imager): all 692 public cases

metadata_files.what: grep of PatientAge/PatientSex/StudyDate over meta/<case>/metadata.yaml (692 cases)

cobra.note: COBRA2026 ships no DICOM but a metadata.yaml per case whose ct block carries PatientAge and PatientSex (and StudyDate). Over the 692 public cases the raw PatientSex values are {'F': 140, 'M': 179, 'U': 120, 'null': 253} ('U' = unknown, not counted as a recorded sex) and the age field is {'int': 120, 'NNNY': 227, 'null': 345} (integer years, 'NNNY', or null). The Results sentence's 'no age or sex is released for the radiotherapy set' is therefore not true of COBRA: it releases them for about two thirds of cases.

cobra_detector.label: COBRA2026: the 145 Elekta cases the detector trained on

metadata_files.what: grep of PatientAge/PatientSex/StudyDate over meta/<case>/metadata.yaml (692 cases)

cobra_detector.note: Subset of the row above: the case ids of realxray/cobra_elekta/splits.json (train/val/test).

carmlspine.label: C-ArmLSpine (intraoperative mobile C-arm)
carmlspine.note: None released. Tag census over 58,911 DICOM files of 149 cases: PatientSex top values [['', 58312], ['M', 426]] (4 distinct), PatientBirthDate top values [['20200101', 58312], ['20231112', 304]] (a 2020-01-01 placeholder on 58,312 files); no PatientAge tag. The residual 'M' on a few hundred files is not a per-case field and is not used.

deepfluoro.label: DeepFluoro (cadaveric specimens, mobile C-arm)
deepfluoro.note: None released. The vendor DICOMs carry placeholders: CT PatientAge {'022Y': 81, '000D': 3} on every object including the sawbones and the fiducial phantom, fluoro PatientAge 000Y, and a PatientSex that is 'F' on the sawbones and 'O' on the fiducial (fluoro values over all objects: {'M': 859, 'O': 366, '': 647, 'F': 787}). Not usable as specimen age or sex.

geneva.label: Geneva hip (BV Pulsera, phantom)
geneva.note: One phantom (the 19 split keys are camera views of one object); no person, no age or sex.

ljubljana.label: Ljubljana 2D-3D-GS (PIXIUM 4600, cadaveric L1-L5)
ljubljana.note: One specimen; nothing in the release files. The accompanying paper describes it as from an 80-year-old female; that is a statement in a paper, not released metadata, and is not counted here.
